T: Safe to go back to the buffet.
D: Amity Island's police chief is sure another shark is out there, and nobody wants to hear it.
P: Serve the snacks when the teenagers set sail.
S: Roast chicken torn up and mixed with lemon mayo, piled into soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos, wrapped tight in paper for the boat.
Clam meat or calamari soaked in buttermilk, dredged in cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon.
the fin behind the water skier
Flour tortillas cut into fin shapes, brushed with oil and salt, baked crisp, with a bright tomato and lime salsa.
M: Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and smoked sausage, tipped onto the table.
the chief who just wants a quiet summer
Chuck mince seasoned at the last minute, formed into thick patties, grilled to medium, cheddar melted under a lid, with onion, pickles and lettuce on a toasted bun. Potato chips.
W: Blueberries with sugar and lemon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the teenagers' boats out on the water
Light lager buried in an esky of ice and water for an hour, cracked open on the deck, lemonade for the younger crew.

s.how: Tear 300g roast chicken and mix with 3 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Pile into 4 soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos. Wrap tight in paper for the boat.
Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk. Dredge in 100g cornmeal and 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 200g sliced smoked sausage, 60g butter and a splash of water, then 1kg clams and 500g prawns. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.how: Toss 500g blueberries with 80g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the teenagers' boats out on the water
d.how: Bury eight 375ml bottles of light lager and a 1.25L bottle of lemonade in an esky of ice and water for an hour. Crack them open on deck. Just when you thought it was safe.
